 attrs={}
 for a in cls.body:

 assert attrs=={"START":w["start_ms"],"FINISH":w["finish_ms"]}
 assert attrs["START"]<attrs["FINISH"]<=1767225600000

 results.append({"name":w["name"],"sha256":h,"bounds":attrs})
